texts.zh: 我们位于[pirate_system.GetName]星系的贸易路线没有得到很好的保护，现在近乎变成了法外之地。该恒星系已经吸引了越来越多的海盗、走私贩以及其它各种不法分子，肆无忌惮地掠夺我们的货物。
texts.en: Our trade route in the [pirate_system.GetName] system is poorly protected and passes through what has largely become lawless space. An increasing number of pirates, smugglers and various other criminal elements have been drawn to the system, and they now raid our shipping with near impunity.

texts.zh: 途经[pirate_system.GetName]星系的无防备贸易路线已经引起了一群海盗们的注意。这些匪徒集结了一支大舰队，拦截了该恒星系的大部分贸易。
texts.en: The unprotected trade route that passes through the [pirate_system.GetName] system has attracted the attention of a roving band of pirates. These outlaws have gathered a sizeable fleet that is intercepting much of the system's trade.

texts.zh: 因其贸易路线毫无防备，[pirate_system.GetName]星系已经吸引了大批不法分子，并且在最近的一次权力争夺之后，这些犯罪分子们已经有了足够的组织性，组成了一支大海盗舰队。他们利用这支东拼西凑的舰队疯狂地劫掠恒星系内的贸易船。
texts.en: With its vulnerable and unprotected trade route, the [pirate_system.GetName] system has attracted a large number of ne'er-do-wells, and following a recent power struggle, these criminal degenerates are now sufficiently organized to operate a significant pirate armada. They are using this ragtag fleet to intercept as much trade in the system as they can.

texts.zh:
一小群子个体上出现了罕见的基因突变，可使它们切断与蜂巢思维的部分连接而不会陷入休眠。不过如果离开蜂巢思维太远，这些离群的子个体就会死亡，所以它们盘踞在了位于我们境内的[pirate_system.GetName]星系。

它们并不是碰巧选中的这个恒星系，而是因为我们一支最不设防的贸易路线正好途经该恒星系。那些离群的子个体无疑打算当海盗来维持生计，利用它们的少数简陋飞船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线。
texts.en:
A rare genetic mutation present in a small number of drones has allowed them to partly sever their connection to the Mind without being rendered comatose. As these rogue drones would perish if they ventured too far from the Mind's influence, they have established themselves in the [pirate_system.GetName] system within our borders.

This system was not chosen at random - one of our most vulnerable trade routes passes through it, and the rogue drones no doubt intend to sustain themselves by living as pirates, using their small fleet of crude spacecraft to raid our shipping.

texts.zh: 一群外星海盗已经潜入并盘踞在了位于我们境内的[pirate_system.GetName]星系。我们有一条不设防的贸易路线途经该恒星系，它们似乎打算掠夺这条贸易路线来维持自己的犯罪活动。
texts.en: A group of alien pirates have infiltrated and established themselves in the [pirate_system.GetName] system, inside our space. To fund their criminal activities, they appear intent on raiding our unprotected trade route that passes through that system.

texts.zh: 一小群故障的单位已经脱离了[Root.GetName]的主体智能，并躲进了我们境内的[pirate_system.GetName]星系。这些单位已经无可救药，并开始利用简陋的舰船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，掠夺零件和资源。
texts.en: A small group of malfunctioning units have separated themselves from the main intelligence of the [Root.GetName], and sought refuge in the [pirate_system.GetName] system inside our space. These units have become irredeemably corrupted, and they now use crude spacecraft to raid the system's unprotected trade route for spare parts and resources.

texts.zh: 一小群有机生物体的犯罪分子已经设法潜入并盘踞于我们境内的[pirate_system.GetName]星系。他们似乎打算打劫途经该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，或许是心存有机生物常见的侥幸心理，误以为他们的存在无关紧要，不会令我们动用武力。
texts.en: A small group of organic sub-units, apparently criminal outcasts, have somehow infiltrated and established themselves in the [pirate_system.GetName] system inside our borders. They seem intent on raiding the system's undefended trade route, perhaps gambling, as organics are wont to do, on the mistaken notion that they are too insignificant to warrant an armed response from us.
